name: Dr Binocs Show

curriculum.summary: Dr Binocs Show is an animated science show that answers "what if" questions about nature and the body, such as what happens if you stop sleeping, plus photosynthesis, the water cycle and the structure of the Earth. It first aired on the Peekaboo channel from 2015. A parental review notes that the show calls homework more harmful than helpful, and that some videos carry personal or political views.
